capabilities: Convert Journey ZIP backups into dated Markdown notes
Preview entry counts, warnings and output paths before importing
Copy entry photos into the attachments folder and embed them
Write frontmatter for date, timezone, tags, mood, location and weather
Merge entries into daily notes with time headings (Pro)
extras: Freemium: separate notes and photos are free; daily-note merge, year/month folders and file name patterns require a paid Pro unlock via GitHub Sponsors, shared across all NoteMods plugins. ZIP input is capped at 128 MiB / 10,000 files, imports are not deduplicated across runs, and the plugin opens a promotional 'What's new' tab after updates. HEIC display depends on the device; newer Journey export schemas and mobile platforms were not tested.
problem: Obsidian cannot read Journey's ZIP backup format, so diary entries and their photos stay locked in that app's export.

relations.evidence: Journey Diary Import converts a Journey diary ZIP backup into dated Markdown notes with photos.
Tests use the public 2021 two-entry fixture from journey-markdown-converter

summary: Imports a Journey diary ZIP backup into a vault as dated Markdown notes with copied photos and frontmatter, plus an optional daily-note merge.
